about: Which sprite-contract slot plays for each thing Zhusha does in Tesu (lanes/anim/SPRITE-CONTRACT.md). normal = her base form, ult = the form after R. A role whose slot has no anim.json in public/assets/zhusha/ (or null) draws the white box. hold = a non-loop clip keeps its last drawing; reverse = played backwards. Dropped by Dex: run_start, e_hold, uf_run_start, uf_run_stop, and run_stop (10-19: the run cuts straight to idle).

jumpArc.about: jump_arc is one clip from takeoff to the settle. The game plays its rise while she rises, holds its apex/fall drawings while she falls, and plays the rest after touchdown. Fractions of the clip; an anim.json may override them with "segments": [apex, contact] as frame indices.
